payload.title: Figure 21 pointed modular comparison phase-aligned
payload.top_notice: The pointed modular Figure 21 batch is complete for the recorded rank 2-5 pointed rows. The raw same-label rank-2 comparison has a recorded +1/-1 output bucket swap, but the regenerated rank2/rank3 comparison artifact proves that both rank-2 semion rows match the split CP2#9(-CP2) standard distribution after the explicit output phase multiplier -1. Rank 3, rank 4, and rank 5 already match with the identity output phase. Thus the pointed rank 2-5 rows have no recorded distribution difference after the stated nonzero-projector and output-phase alignment rule. This is still not an H2-certified exoticness theorem and not a global no-signal theorem.
